# Loop Found

> Loop Found is a web design and development company in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. A founder-led team of three designs, builds and launches business websites, web applications and landing pages for clients across India.

Contact: team@loopfound.in, +91 6379586015, +91 8148448835. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/teamloopfound/

## Services

- [Web Design](https://www.loopfound.in/services/web-design): website structure, visual design systems and responsive layouts
- [Web Development](https://www.loopfound.in/services/web-development): fast, maintainable websites and web apps (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.loopfound.in/services/ui-ux-design): user flows, wireframes and interface design
- [Website Redesign](https://www.loopfound.in/services/website-redesign): rebuilding outdated sites while protecting search rankings
- [Technical SEO](https://www.loopfound.in/services/seo-optimization): crawlability, metadata, structured data, sitemaps and Search Console
